correctness.rationale: The full proof establishes the twisted matrix Gauss identity by unipotent averaging, proves vanishing for singular Fourier coefficients using nontrivial determinant stabilizers, performs additive inversion for diagonal constraints, evaluates all nontrivial determinant-character moments via the Gauss product, and applies multiplicative Fourier inversion.
